Name: Weed Mod
Author: Aidanb416
Description:
[color=#e8e6e3]Adds 2 different growable crop types, Indica and Sativa.[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
Indica and Sativa can be crafted into 5 different strains of weed, including... [/color][list]
[*][color=#e8e6e3]Pineapple Express (Pineapple)[/color]
[*][color=#e8e6e3]Blue Dream (Blueberry)[/color]
[*][color=#e8e6e3]Gelato (Ice Cream) [/color]
[*][color=#e8e6e3]Flapjacks (Pancakes) [/color]
[*][color=#e8e6e3]Tangie (Orange) [/color]
[/list][color=#e8e6e3]
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]Indica and Sativa seeds are obtained in a new Robin 2 heart cutscene.[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
Recipes are mailed to you by Sebastian after reaching 2 hearts with him.[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
Rolling Paper can be crafted by smelting soggy newspapers in a furnace and Bongs can be crafted with any mineral.[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
All strains of weed can be crafted into bongs, joints and edibles which give a -25 energy debuff, a +2 luck buff and +3 strain-specific buff![/color][color=#e8e6e3]
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]
Other drugs are planned for release in the future.[/color][color=#e8e6e3]


[/color][color=#e8e6e3]Code written by Aidan Birmingham
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]Art create by Elizabeth Payne
[/color][color=#e8e6e3]Dialogue and Descriptions by Ava Dumitrescu[/color]
